propositions: Core command handlers in _commands/, _engine_support/, and _io/ currently parse argv imperatively, creating duplicate grammars that argparse documentation definitions would replicate.

Each core Route in _registry.py lacks a parser_factory reference; only advanced/intercept routes carry one, and runtime dispatch in __init__.py uses imperative handler switches instead of factory-based parsing.

Per-command argparse factories must be created in _cli/_parsers/core/ following the S2a contract, then wired onto core Routes and used by _dispatch_* handlers to eliminate imperative grammar while preserving per-family unknown-token semantics (skip vs reject-exit-2).

Global flags (--output, -o, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) are extracted router-level before per-command factories see argv; factories must not re-declare these and must preserve existing diagnostic text, stdout/stderr, and exit codes.
Existing production-path behavior, persisted effects, refusal modes, and exit codes must show no unapproved deltas; metrics command is excluded as already migrated in S2c.
